Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.05 per reception constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 20 receptions. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout.
